camel_example: aliyun agentidentity CreateUserPoolClient --region cn-hangzhou --ClientName 'my-web-app' --SecretRequired true --Scopes '["openid"]' --AccessTokenValidity 3600 --RedirectURIs '["https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"]' --EnforcePKCE true --RefreshTokenValidity 86400 --UserPoolName 'my-agent-userpool' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity create-user-pool-client --user-pool-name my-agent-userpool --client-name my-web-app --redirect-ur-is https://app.example.com/oauth/callback --secret-required true --enforce-pkce true --access-token-validity 3600 --refresh-token-validity 86400 --scopes openid --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUserPoolClient

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the client. The name must be unique within the same user pool and be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端名称。在同一用户池内唯一，长度 1~64 个字符
parameters.name: client_name

parameters.help_en: The list of OAuth redirect URIs. After authorization is complete, the user's browser is redirected to one of the URIs in the list
parameters.help_zh: OAuth 回调地址列表。授权完成后用户浏览器将被重定向到列表中的某个地址
parameters.name: redirect_ur_is

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether an application secret is required. Valid values:
true: Required. This applies to confidential clients such as server-side applications. You must call CreateClientSecret to create a secret.
false: Not required. This applies to public clients such as single-page applications (SPAs) and mobile applications
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要应用密钥。取值：
true：需要密钥，机密客户端（如服务端应用），需通过 CreateClientSecret 创建密钥。
false：不需要密钥，公共客户端（如 SPA、移动应用）
parameters.name: secret_required

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enforce Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE). Valid values:
true: Enforced. The code_challenge parameter is required in the authorization code flow.
false: Not enforced
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制启用 PKCE（Proof Key for Code Exchange）。取值：
true：强制启用，授权码模式必须携带 code_challenge。
false：不强制启用
parameters.name: enforce_pkce

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the access token, in seconds. Valid values: 900 to 10800. Default value: 3600
parameters.help_zh: 访问令牌有效期，单位秒。取值范围：900~10800，默认 3600
parameters.name: access_token_validity

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the refresh token, in seconds. Valid values: 7200 to 31536000 (90 days). Default value: 2592000 (30 days)
parameters.name: refresh_token_validity

parameters.help_en: The scopes granted to the application. You can specify multiple scopes
parameters.help_zh: 授予该应用的权限范围信息，可填写多个范围
parameters.name: scopes

AccessTokenValidity.description_en: The validity period of the access token, in seconds
AccessTokenValidity.description_zh: 访问令牌有效期，单位秒

ClientScopes.description_en: The list of default scopes for the client
ClientScopes.description_zh: 客户端默认授权范围列表

Required.description_en: Specifies whether the scope is required

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the client was created, in ISO 8601 format (UTC)
CreateTime.description_zh: 客户端创建时间。ISO 8601 格式（UTC）

RedirectURIs.description_en: The list of OAuth redirect URIs

RefreshTokenValidity.description_en: The validity period of the refresh token, in seconds
RefreshTokenValidity.description_zh: 刷新令牌有效期，单位秒

SecretRequired.description_en: Specifies whether an application secret is required

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the client was updated, in ISO 8601 format (UTC)
UpdateTime.description_zh: 客户端更新时间。ISO 8601 格式（UTC）

UserPoolName.description_en: The name of the user pool
